title: Can Pinnacle Blooms' therapy sessions assist in improving my child's eye contact?
metaTitle: Enhance Eye Contact Skill in Children with Autism | Pinnacle Blooms Therapy Sessions
description: Discover how Pinnacle Blooms' therapy sessions aim to improve eye contact and social skills in children with autism through ABA therapy. Learn about our holistic approach to support your child.
html: Yes, ABA therapy attempts to improve social skills like maintaining eye contact, through positive reinforcement techniques. Incremental progress is sought – taking into account the comfort level of the child.
